The affected credit unions were contacted about the potential data breach earlier this week by Belfast-based IT company Wellington IT. It is understood...

events.headline: Tor releases emergency update amid ongoing DDoS attack on relays
events.alleged_cause: The Tor Project says an ongoing distributed denial-of-service attack has overwhelmed relays and affected most operators.
events.summary: The Tor Project has released a security update for its network relay software to increase defenses against an ongoing distributed denial-of-service attack that it says has overwhelmed relays and affected most operators. [...]

events.alleged_cause: The NSA's preliminary statement says there is no evidence the outage was caused by a cyberattack.
events.summary: The NSA has ordered staggered arrivals at its headquarters at Fort Meade, Maryland, as technicians work to fully restore the classified internal network NSA Net.

events.alleged_cause: The hospital says a week-long server outage was caused by a cyber incident; the investigation into affected data is ongoing.
events.summary: Jackson Stoever reports: Monadnock Community Hospital said on Monday its week-long server outage is due to a “cyber incident.” The ongoing investigation now includes determining what data was affected. events.headline: Access Dental data breach affects over 340,000 people
events.alleged_cause: Hackers breached the company's network and stole personal, health and insurance information.
events.summary: Hackers breached Access Dental’s network and stole personal, health, and insurance information. The post Access Dental Management Data Breach Impacts Over 340,000 appeared first on SecurityWeek .

events.alleged_cause: A suspected supply chain attack on Optimizely led to malicious JavaScript being loaded on many popular websites.
